summary: Frontend-only verification of the WebsiteEditor draft-preview fix and public site rendering. Logged in as super-admin (pzsuave007@gmail.com), opened /pagina-web, confirmed site is in Draft, and validated href values for the 3 view/preview affordances. Also validated the public preview URL renders a full template with hero, headline and loaded images.
verified_behaviors: data-testid=website-view-site anchor href = https://guided-quotes.preview.emergentagent.com/sitio/uni2-marketing-agency?preview=1 (ends with ?preview=1 in Draft).
ExternalLink icon anchor next to website-url row href = .../sitio/uni2-marketing-agency?preview=1.
All 10 template thumbnails render in editor: website-tpl-{cinematic,responder,bento,craftsman,trust,slider,onepage,neon,playful,luxe}.

Public URL /sitio/uni2-marketing-agency?preview=1 renders full template: data-testid=site-tpl-craftsman, h1='Digital Marketing That Works Nationwide', 8/8 loaded with naturalWidth>0, and 'not available' text is NOT present.
critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteEditor.js is 700 lines — consider splitting into smaller subcomponents (Templates, Gallery, BeforeAfter, Domain, Content) for maintainability.

viewUrl only appends ?preview=1 while !published; consider also appending when the owner is authenticated regardless of publish state, so previewing after publishing (e.g. staging content) still works consistently.
test_credentials: pzsuave007@gmail.com / Uni2mkt007! (super-admin, site slug uni2-marketing-agency, Draft).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: In WebsiteEditor.js, viewUrl (const at line ~54) correctly appends ?preview=1 when w.published is false, and is wired to the ExternalLink anchor (line ~274), website-view-site anchor (line ~290), and website-preview anchor uses publicUrl+?preview=1 explicitly (line ~291). All three anchors now open the public site in preview mode so the owner sees the template instead of the 404 'This website is not available' page. Public rendering of /sitio/uni2-marketing-agency?preview=1 is healthy (craftsman template, real hero/h1/images).
rca of the issue: Root cause: the owner's website (slug uni2-marketing-agency) is in Draft (published=false). The public route /sitio/:slug returns 404 'This website is not available.' for unpublished sites unless ?preview=1 is provided. Previously, the editor's 'View my site', 'Preview draft', and ExternalLink anchors opened publicUrl without ?preview=1, so the owner always saw the 404 and reported 'no se ve ningún template'. Fix: added viewUrl = publicUrl + '?preview=1' when !w.published and wired it to the three affordances. Mitigation verified end-to-end via Playwright: hrefs contain ?preview=1 while Draft, and the public preview URL renders the full craftsman template with hero image, headline, and all 8 images loaded.
